channel.title: CWI Listening Room — Weekly Sessions
channel.description: The weekly listening session from Cumulative Web Inc's Listening Room. Every Friday night at 8 PM Eastern, hosts Marcus and Nia open the doors, press play together with the room, and put the spotlight on the music coming out of the label — premieres, deep cuts, and the stories behind them. Setlists are published ahead of time; every track is labeled, and verified Spotify links are in the show notes.
